body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Customizing Fade Start still works too.

I couldn't spot a performance difference on my RTX 4090, but it's clearly not bottlenecked by this at any resolution.

PS: We should find a way to add a CLI argument to force llvmpipe on 3.x like we have `--gpu-index 1` on 4.x; it would make it easier to reproduce a (very) slow GPU situation. I couldn't find a way to force it on my end so far.
